bugs.title: Wrong serial prefix and format for temperature line
bugs.description: Line 34 prints "temp=" instead of the required "Temp: " prefix, so no line ever matches the required pattern. The measured evidence confirms no serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s across all scenarios, including the nominal ramp. No serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

bugs.title: Range lamp chatters at threshold with no hysteresis
bugs.description: Line 28 compares the reported value against the bounds with a bare >=/<= test and no hysteresis, so analogRead noise and quantization around the threshold toggle D7 every loop. The measured evidence shows D7 in the wrong state for 3860 ms across 1571 intervals at the -10 C hover and 3564 ms across 1346 intervals with noise. D7 was in the wrong state for 3860 ms across 1571 interval(s), first at 501 ms: D7 was not LOW for 2 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

bugs.title: Lamp follows live value during freeze and chatters at bounds
bugs.description: Lines 52-55 re-latch frozenC from the live sample on every loop while D5 is LOW, so the hold does not freeze at the last pre-press value, and line 58 drives the lamp from that drifting value. Combined with the hysteresis-free comparison on line 28, the measured evidence shows D7 wrong for 3549 ms across 29 intervals during a long hold and 2941 ms across 1177 intervals at the 50 C hover. D7 was in the wrong state for 2941 ms across 1177 interval(s), first at 504 ms: D7 was not LOW for 1 ms while required (grace 500 ms).
